text:
ana: Thanks for joining the security segment — posting follow-ups here.

ravi: I'll own the SOC2 evidence mapping and share a control-owner sheet by Friday.

morgan: For ISO scope: align with SOC2 prod footprint or reduce for speed?

kelly: Recommend align with SOC2 but consider excluding low-risk non-prod tools.

ravi: KMS BYOK: supported for Private customers. Need onboarding checklist (grants, rotation, access reviews). @jordan can you draft with IAM roles?

jordan: Will open PR. Including bootstrapping snippets:
```bash
aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/rwinference-customer-<id> --target-key-id <key-id>
aws kms create-grant --key-id <key-id> --grantee-principal <service-role-arn> --operations Decrypt Encrypt
```
security-bot: Docs: https://docs.redwood.example/security/kms-byok and runbook link posted.

ana: Audit logs question: hosted retention 90 days; Dedicated/Private configurable. We should add Console export/S3 option.

morgan: I'll create ticket for Console export; ACs: include user id, request id, model id, timestamp, request/response hash.

kelly: Confirm encryption-at-rest for logs: default service KMS vs customer KMS when BYOK?

ravi: Default service KMS. Can switch to customer key with legal + infra signoff when BYOK enabled.

ana: VPC peering vs PrivateLink?

jordan: Recommend PrivateLink for cross-account and reduced routing exposure; peering ok for same-org. Decision matrix to be added.

ops-bot: Task SEC-847 created and assigned to ravi, due 2026-04-15.

morgan: Owning SEC-852 for Console export, ticket with ACs by Monday.

ravi: Will draft FAQ about KMS rotation windows and rewrap behavior.

ana: Pls add owners and due dates to sheet: https://sheets.redwood.example/sec-followups.

kelly: We'll prioritize in Product + Security sync.

morgan: Request security share SOC2 control narratives for Platform Availability; product wants to align SLOs.

ravi: Will attach narratives to SEC-847 by Friday.

ana: If no objections I'll close thread after sheet + tickets done. Thanks all!
